recentItems.title: Baby Dolls Play Guess the Groove 🎶🔥 Can They Guess Every Song?
recentItems.description:
🎶 Okay but... who actually knows the songs better? 👀

Baby Dolls take on the Guess the Groove Challenge and let's just say... things did NOT go as expected 😭🔥

From instant guesses to total brain freezes, watch the girls battle it out as they try to name the songs from just a few seconds of audio. Some rounds were easy. Some rounds had everybody STRESSED. And one song? Yeah... nobody saw that coming. 🤯

💖 Play along and comment: 👇 How many did YOU get right? 👇 Which round had you screaming at your screen?

recentItems.title: WRIVE - 'Sumayaw Ka' feat. Cianne Dominguez Official Lyric Video
recentItems.description:
Rising P-pop group, WRIVE, pay homage to the legendary Gloc-9 by putting a modern spin on the feel-good OPM classic Sumayaw Ka. With its catchy beat and playful lyrics, the song reminds us to let loose, forget our problems for a while, and keep moving even when life gets tough.
